metadata.title: Interactive Curriculum Learning Decreases and Homogenizes Motor Variability
metadata.description: This dataset contains movement data collected from 36 participants over two days. The experiment measures motor learning over 2 days after a specific training schedule. The task involved steering a cursor in a channel-arc to trace a free-form trajectory. The goal was to remain inside the channel while trying to make smooth movements. Day 1 folder contains data for the pre-test, training and post-test phases of the experiment. Day 2 folder contains data for the retention and transfer phases of the experiment. The files are annotated as follows PX-Y, where X is the participant ID and Y is the condition acronym which is either EA (Error Adaptation), CL (Curriculum Learning) or RM (Random). There are two files per folder, the json file is a configuration file used to specify the condition and create the schedule. The db file contains the recorded data for all timestamps, with columns user_id ,trial_id, block_id, width, length, algo, icf. The user_id is a verbose participant id which was randomly generated. The width and length are the dimensions of the channel. 'algo' is the condition and 'icf' is the performance metric. The field 'algo' has values 'mabuni', 'schedule' or 'choilike'. They correspond to Curriculum Learning, Random and Error Adaptation respectively. The field icf has values between 0 and 1 except when it has not yet been calculated e.g. before the end of a trial, then the value is -1.
